description: A row of chips for picking an option; the chip you click swells and the others give way with a springy shove.
interactionNotes: Click any chip and it grows while the others shrink slightly and move aside; the farther away they are, the later they go. You can also move between options with the arrow keys, and Home/End jump to either end. Selection is the same with click and keyboard, so both feel identical.

props.items: The options; you can pass strings, or objects with value, label, icon and disabled.
props.value: Controlled value. If you want uncontrolled, do not pass this and pass defaultValue instead.
props.defaultValue: The selected option in uncontrolled mode; defaults to the first option.
props.onChange: Returns the new option's value and index on every selection.
props.size: Chip size: sm 28, md 36 and lg 44 pixels.
props.chipColor: Background color of the inactive chips.
props.activeColor: Background color of the selected chip.
props.textColor: Text color of the inactive chips; the same color is used when the pointer moves over them.
props.activeTextColor: Text color of the selected chip.
props.radius: Corner radius of the chips; for a fully pill-shaped chip, pass half the height.
props.swell: How much larger the active chip grows, relative to its own size.
props.barge: How many extra pixels the neighbours are pushed aside.
props.jelly: Intensity of the jelly feel. At 0 the motion becomes a simple zoom; above 1 the stretch gets exaggerated.
props.bounce: Spring bounciness. Above 0.4 it looks too resonant.
props.stagger: Time offset at which each neighbour starts moving, in milliseconds.
props.stiffness: Spring stiffness; lower means softer and slower.
props.disabled: Disables and dims the whole group.
props.ariaLabel: Group label for screen readers; keep it close to the question's topic.
props.className: Extra class on the group root; for custom spacing or width.

tips: For choices picked over and over, set `bounce` around 0.15; less bounce, calmer.
If the chip labels are long, increase `size` rather than `gap`; a large gap scatters the group.
You can also pass colors with a CSS variable, like `var(--color-brand)`.
